module: Path recording for the Drive Path Editor: while the player drives a vehicle, the module samples its position and speed every second, then on stop creates a new "Recorded_<name>" spline linked to that vehicle, simplified by the RDP algorithm.
notes: Constants: sampling rate 1 s, RDP tolerance 3.0, default width 10 m, default speed limit 100, minimum recorded speed 3 m/s, nodes closer than ~2 m (distance² <= 4.1) are merged.
The created spline has routeSpeedMode = 'off' and speedProfileMode = 1 (per-node speeds); widths = 10, nmls = (0,0,1), velLimits = 100 for all nodes.
stopRecord assumes a recording has been started: without a recorded vehicle (recordingVehicle nil) the function would raise an error.

getRecordingTime.desc: Time elapsed since the start of recording.

handleRecord.desc: To be called every frame: advances the timer and adds a point (position, speed >= 3 m/s) every second. No effect if no vehicle is being recorded.

startRecord.desc: Starts recording: stores the vehicle, makes the player enter it (be:enterVehicle(0, ...)), clears the data and records the first point.

vehicle.desc: editor vehicle entry with .veh (vehicle object) and .name

stopRecord.desc: Ends recording: adds a path spline linked to the vehicle, copies positions and speeds, removes nearby duplicates, simplifies via rdp.simplifyNodesVels and resets the state.

sceneVehicles.desc: scene vehicles; the matching entry receives isLink = true and linkSplineId
